decisions.claim: npm install -g can resolve newer deps than the lockfile
decisions.reason: true of every release; the signed archive (what Update now installs) uses the lockfile. Range floor ^1.32.2 guarantees the fixed SDK. Not in scope.

Identified: test/lock.test.ts 'reports the credential as taken while held, and free once released' fails the same way on unchanged 2.5.0 when two full suites run at once (load/timing). Pre-existing, not caused by this change. 2.5.1: lock.test.ts 10/10 passes alone; full suite runs 2 and 3 pass 2519/2519.
